notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
